newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish bourse kerb bond deals - December 3.
newsitem.headline: Polish bourse kerb bond deals - December 3.

text.p: Turnover in kerb trade through the Warsaw Stock Exchange was 13.8 million zlotys on Tuesday.
The following is a summary of the day's block transactions on the Warsaw bourse.
* 1,862 fixed-interest five-year bonds maturing on February 12, 2000 traded at 95.35 zlotys.
* 929 fixed-interest five-year bonds maturing on June 12, 2000 traded at 95.3 zlotys.
* 102,367 variable-interest three-year bonds maturing on August 6, 1998 traded at 104.9 zlotys.
